      <description><p>There is no end in sight for the drivers of illegal mining, while police action appears ineffective</p><p>Cora Bailey has been encountering illegal miners ever since she first started treating injured animals in the townships around Roodepoort, west of Johannesburg, in 1991.       <description><p>Alliance for the Future, unveiled at Montreal summit and open to other countries, conceived for world ‘shaken by new storms’</p><p>Canada and Europe have announced a new alliance of like-minded nations to<strong> </strong>serve as both a “protective canopy under which our citizens can thrive” and a powerful hedge against the unpredictable nature of geopolitics, while welcoming other countries to join.</p><p>Speaking to reporters on Friday from Montreal, the prime minister, Mark Carney, and the European Commission president, Ursula von der Leyen, called the new partnership the Alliance for the Future and said the “deepest possible partnership between Canada and the 27-member bloc had the potential to offer unprecedented stability and opportunity”.</p> <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/oct/30/canada-european-union-alliance">Continue reading...</a></description>

      <description><p>Turkey has been hit by powerful thunderstorms and a fatal tornado this week with more heavy rain expected</p><p>Heavy rain and strong winds will continue to affect parts of south-eastern Europe and Turkey over the next few days, as an area of low pressure in the region has allowed for the formation of powerful thunderstorms.
